summary.text: South Korea won by 42 runs. SKR made 172-7, Balage Dilruksha (c & wk) top-scoring with 44 off 31 balls; Ida Bagus Nara took 3 for 27. IDN made 130-8, Kavin Neeraj Chaddha top-scoring with 61 off 48 balls; Areeb Khalid took 3 for 12. Sides batting first at Yeonhui Cricket Ground usually make about 119.

preview.text: South Korea and Indonesia meet in a T20 match at Yeonhui Cricket Ground, where Indonesia won the toss and chose to bowl first.
